newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger expects a "good year" in '97.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger expects a "good year" in '97.

text.p: Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie AG, the world's biggest brickmaker, assessed 1996 a "very good year" and forecast another "good year" in 1997.
"From my point of view 1996 was a very good year that brought us exactly what we had aimed for," chief executive Erhard Schaschl told journalists.
The budget for 1997 would be "something to behold", he continued, without giving further details.
In October Wienerberger forecast 1996 pre-tax profit of 1.2-1.4 billion schillings, below last year's 1.5 billion and slightly short of the firm's original 1.4 billion target.
Wienerberger shares took a knock in the summer after the group reported disappointing six-month results due to a general downturn in the construction industry.
But they have since recovered and on Thursday were trading at 2,048 schillings, comfortably above August's year-low of 1,880.
